deterministic_tests.scope: Includes real directory creation in synthetic temporary sessions, repeat-run preservation, path validation, and existing reader/evidence tests.

observations: The first run did not invoke the skill tool and read an older personal copy.
After synchronizing the personal copy and requiring native invocation, the skill tool returned Skill not found.
A separate read-only native skill listing did discover the updated v0.5.0 description.
native_delivery_smoke.result: Native end-to-end delivery behavior is not claimed verified. No CLI settings were changed to work around discovery.

limitations: No real case or session content was regenerated by these tests.
The directory helper does not redact content or write article bodies.
Independent semantic review and publication remain separate gates.
